event_name: Time 20:07 2020 TURKISH GRAND PRIX 12 - 15 November 2020 Due to force majeure, the ASN steward, Fatih Altayli is not available only for the evening of the 14th November. Under the authority of the Stewards under Art 11.9.3.n of the International Sporting Code, the Stewards amend Appendix 1, Part A of the Formula One Sporting Regulations for this Event and nominate Mr. Jacob Boulter to replace Mr. Altayli after being nominated by TOSFED (Turkish ASN).
title: Stewards Substitution
